headline: A 2022 law renames a Veterans Affairs center in Orem, Utah, after Colonel Gail Halvorsen, the "Candy Bomber" pilot.
what_it_does: The law changes the official name of the Provo Veterans Center in Orem, Utah, which is run by the Department of Veterans Affairs. The new name is the Col. Gail S. Halvorsen "Candy Bomber" Veterans Center. The law does not change what services the center offers or how it operates.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on June 7, 2022.
